title: W-qos root fix's resolve lane-threshold margin has no unit-level pin — bundle_lane_at has zero references outside core/crisis.odin
evidence:
core/crisis.odin: "relieved := bound > margin &&
    bundle_class_queue(state, cat, b, ac.class) + margin < bound &&
    !bundle_lane_at(state, cat, b, bound - margin)
cleared = relieved &&". grep -rn "bundle_lane_at " core/*.odin returns only core/crisis.odin definitions/calls — no test file references it.
detail: The r2 churn fix's key condition (no lane at/above bound-margin blocks resolution — including a lane held by ANOTHER class) is exercised only indirectly by the qos.t1/warn.t1 golden streams; no core test constructs the boundary. Golden-level only.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test: crisis active on a bundle whose class backlog is below bound-margin while a lane sits at bound-margin (other-class-held) — assert no resolve.

title: The (b) drop-fallback trigger's drop-site attribution is never distinguished by any test — the settled-scan test pins the (a) branch only
